ov: The Atlantic cod is a large, brown or green spotted fish of the North Atlantic, one of the most widely eaten fish in the world.

why.et: One of the most widely eaten fish.

rg: The North Atlantic: from North Carolina to Greenland in the west, and from the Bay of Biscay to the Arctic Ocean, the Baltic and the North Sea in the east.
fx: Females release their eggs in 5–20 batches, a few days apart.
notes: The existing fact is confirmed: a female spawns between 200,000 and 15 million eggs.
